name: Contingency direct-hire desk: controls, automation & I&C engineers for Illinois manufacturers, integrators and engineering firms
summary: Customer = hiring company that has paid at least one placement fee. First placement fee is modeled as one-time revenue at the moment a client is 'won'; repeat placements from active clients are modeled as recurring revenue (expected repeat fees per month). Fees are net of fallout/realization. Founder-led desk; a junior recruiter is added once revenue supports it. Operating profit is before founder pay.
evidence_notes: Fee: 20% of first-year base is the most common North American direct-hire fee (SIA survey via secondary source) [D, C9-S025]; platforms cite 15-25% with 60-90-day guarantees, net-30 [D, C9-S024].
Salaries for Illinois controls engineers: ZipRecruiter Chicago $81-120k; ExpressPros Champaign $74.2-115k; Rivian Normal staff level $125.8-157.2k [D, DG-S034]. Base salary $105k.
Realization: Kforce books direct hire net of a fallout reserve with a <=90-day fallout period [A, WS12-S009]; 85% realization is E.

Demand: 25 named Illinois employers with current controls/automation/I&C postings (Sargent & Lundy alone lists 20+ I&C/automation roles) [D, DG-S020..S039]; several roles posted 30+ days (Ingredion, Medline, Abbott, Primient) [D].

Competition: Illinois JobLink shows controls postings by Actalent and Aerotek [D, DG-S034]; Abbott runs a separate Workday 'Agency' site [D, DG-S026] - large employers channel agencies through vendor portals.

Tools priced: Recruit CRM $95-215/user/mo [B, DG-S040]; Loxo from $149 [B, DG-S041]; Top Echelon split network $135-150/mo + $350 startup [B, DG-S043]. LinkedIn Recruiter price not published (MISSING, DG-S045).
Cyclicality: Robert Half perm placement -13.6% in 2025, +6.2% Q3 2026 [A, WS12-S008, C9-S023]. No Illinois licence for employer-paid recruiters [A, C9-S022].

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: No IDOL licence/bond for employer-paid recruiters [A, C9-S022]; only entity, fee agreement and tools.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Job order to start typically 30-90 days plus sourcing time; first fee ~4 months after first outreach (E); Paraform claims ~12-day fills on its marketplace [D, C9-S024].
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Recruiting craft learnable in 6-12 months (Stage A, E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Hiring-manager conversations about a specific open controls/automation role; universe evidenced by public postings [D, DG-S020..S039]; rate is an estimate. Optimistic capped at 10 because one recruiter's capacity is ~20-25 placements/yr including repeats (E).
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Conversation -> signed fee agreement / job order; analyst estimate.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Contingency job order -> placement (fill ratio). Non-exclusive orders compete with in-house TA and other agencies; analyst estimate.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Junior recruiter first-time-client placements; analyst estimate.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Placed engineers moving jobs and hiring managers changing employers refer the desk; estimate.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Non-exclusive relationships lapse after hiring needs end; 5%/month = ~20-month average active life; estimate.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Repeat placements per active client per year x realized fee / 12: cons 0.5 x $13,680; base 0.45 x $17,850; opt 0.5 x $22,770.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Realized first fee: cons $95k x 18% x 0.80; base $105k x 20% x 0.85; opt $115k x 22% x 0.90. Salary D [DG-S034]; fee D [C9-S025]; realization E with A-level fallout mechanism [WS12-S009].
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Salary inflation lifts fee base; RH average fee rose 3.8% in 2025 [A, WS12-S008].
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: RH perm gross margin 99.8% [A, C9-S023]; 95% leaves room for per-search job ads, background checks, candidate travel.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: As above plus first-search job advertising; split-network deals (50/50) would lower this sharply.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Bad debt / fee disputes / payment processing.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Plant visits, lunches, extra InMail/credits per new client.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Sponsored job ads budget; analyst estimate (Indeed/ZipRecruiter price pages blocked).
drivers.dso_days__source: Invoice on start, net-30 [D, C9-S024]; mid-size manufacturers often pay late.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Tools and insurance for ~9 months before fee cash arrives; founder living costs excluded.

staff.notes: Base ~$55k + expected commission + payroll tax; hired once monthly revenue first exceeds $20k; E
